title: Can I SLAY Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess ('Slay'): plays with hard drawbacks vs anonymous humans; frames show Lethal Attraction.
rules: Standard setup; each player gets one secret random drawback (with hard drawbacks enabled); opponent's drawback is revealed after the game.
No check/checkmate: kings can be captured; moving into check is legal; capturing the enemy king wins.
If your drawback makes you have no legal moves / you violate a lose-condition drawback, you lose.
The site highlights moves your drawback requires.
Drawbacks seen: Lethal Attraction: you can't move a piece farther from the opponent's king than it started (frame text)
win_condition: Capture the enemy king / opponent loses by drawback or time. Goal not captured.

opponent.name: online humans (red name, e.g. 'Fluggy'?)
opponent.avatar_description: anonymous adjective-colour-animal name in red, no avatar
